about_the_game:
The truth is optional.

A mysterious pseudo-animal organization illegally kidnaps dogs, for which they organize fundraisers under the pretext of saving their lives.

The reality turns out to be completely different. You stumble upon their fraud, which you want to expose to the whole world, but they will do anything to prevent that from happening.

Story inspired by real events.

Our Little Brothers is a third-person shooter featuring bullet time mechanics and a complex storyline inspired by arthouse cinema from studios like A24.

- Face the dark echoes of your past.

- Save animals held captive in various locations from death.

- Engage in spectacular combat accompanied by advanced environmental destruction and bullet time mechanics.

- Discover a plot full of twists and turns and complex symbolism.

- Fantastic gameplay lasting about two hours at a low price.

- Engaging levels introducing new, unique challenges.

- All this in the face of the inevitable apocalypse.

The game runs on the Unreal Engine 5 and is highly optimized to run on as many computer devices available on the market as possible, so that a large group of players can enjoy it.

name: Our Little Brothers

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9300H/AMD Ryzen 3 4300U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1650/AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800H/Intel Core i5-12500H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce RTX 3070/AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Save kidnapped dogs. Rescue them from death at the hands of a criminal organization. Our Little Brothers is a spectacular third-person shooter in which, with the help of bullet time and environmental destruction, you can save many four-legged lives and uncover a terrifying conspiracy.
supported_languages: English, Polish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian
